research_sources.table:
CREATE TABLE research_sources (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	topic_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL, 
	url VARCHAR(2048) NOT NULL, 
	publisher VARCHAR(255), 
	published_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	snippet TEXT, 
	source_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	discovered_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_sources_topic_url UNIQUE (topic_id, url), 
	FOREIGN KEY(topic_id) REFERENCES topics (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

story_cluster_members.table:
CREATE TABLE story_cluster_members (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	cluster_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	topic_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(cluster_id) REFERENCES story_clusters (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(topic_id) REFERENCES topics (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_story_cluster_members_topic_id ON story_cluster_members (topic_id)

story_clusters.table:
CREATE TABLE story_clusters (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	summary TEXT NOT NULL, 
	confidence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

topic_analyses.table:
CREATE TABLE topic_analyses (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	topic_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	summary TEXT NOT NULL, 
	relevance INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	research_priority INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	rationale TEXT NOT NULL, 
	research_questions TEXT NOT NULL, 
	model VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	analyzed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(topic_id) REFERENCES topics (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_topic_analyses_topic_id ON topic_analyses (topic_id)

topics.table:
CREATE TABLE topics (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	url VARCHAR(2048) NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	published_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	fetched_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	relevance_score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	freshness_score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	summary TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_topics_url ON topics (url)
